name: Minnesota American Legion Boys State
what_you_do: Spend a week at Saint John's University running a pretend government. You elect city, county and state officials. You go to classes and mock trials. You hear political speakers.
who_can_apply: Young men who have just finished their junior year of high school. The Legion says picks are based on merit and ability. A sponsor, usually a local American Legion Post, chooses from students your school recommends.
pay_detail: Fees are paid by the sponsoring American Legion Post or other community group. No dollar amount is listed. Spending money for the camp store is optional.
duration: One week. 2027 session: check in Sunday June 13, check out Saturday June 19, 2027.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted. Each sponsor sets its own. Ask your school counselor or a local American Legion Post.
how_to_apply: Talk to your school counselor or contact a local American Legion Post. Forms and delegate information are on mnboysstate.org. For questions, call 651-291-1800 or email jkelley@mnlegion.org.
notes: Boys State is for boys. The 2026 session was June 14 to 20 at Saint John's University. Girls State is a separate program run by the American Legion Auxiliary. The Boys State pages give no age number, only the junior-year rule.
